title: Arms Warrior
subtitle: Sequences, not prose — imagined presses through a real kit. See the disclaimer at the end.

sections.heading: Identity
paragraphs: Colossus Smash opens the window; Mortal Strike/Execute/Overpower cash it in. No pet, no combo points — Rage is the resource, but its real per-ability cost isn't cleanly resolvable from this project's spell-description data (unlike Rogue's combo points, which were readable directly), so it's not numerically tracked below. Flagged, not faked.

steps.tag: team-wide, save for a real all-in

disclaimer: This guide was written by Claude (an AI) — not a dictated expert module, not the same trust tier as the Discipline Priest or Feral Druid canonical modules elsewhere on this site. Every ability/cooldown/category is real, live data. The Opener/Sustained/CC-Woven/Defensive Ladder sequences are IMAGINED — my own constructed presses through this real kit, not derived from a real logged match. Rage costs are NOT modeled — unlike Rogue's combo points, this project's spell data doesn't cleanly surface per-ability Rage cost, so sequence order here reflects logical priority (cooldown windows, execute-range gating, DR-diverse CC chaining), not a verified resource budget. Recklessness, Rallying Cry, Piercing Howl, and Intervene were all missing from this guide's first version — none were in the site-wide 'selectable kit' view at all (same baseline-visibility gap already documented for Rogue's Envenom/Rupture/Mutilate), found only by falling back to a direct spell lookup. The Real Observed Window section is measured from real archived matches, not imagined.
